verdict.rationale: Expensify documents some background automations it runs itself. Users can build workspace rules by asking its AI, finalized reports export automatically to QuickBooks Online, and SmartScan extracts receipt data automatically in realtime. There is no evidence of a general facility for users to define and schedule autonomous agent-style automations. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose automation or agent builder, scheduling or trigger configuration for background tasks, details on what rules can do autonomously, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
